_method: Estimated from raw ingredients using USDA FoodData Central. Cooking losses are not modelled and added salt is excluded, so sodium is not given.

water.note: contributes no energy in the amounts used

basmati-rice.usda: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, unenriched

sattu.approx: roasted gram flour approximated by chickpea flour

dalia.approx: broken wheat approximated by durum wheat

bajra-flour.approx: pearl millet flour approximated by generic millet flour

ragi-flour.approx: finger millet flour approximated by generic millet flour

poha.usda: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, unenriched
poha.approx: flattened rice approximated by raw white rice

murmura.approx: puffed rice approximated by a puffed-rice cereal

bread.usda: Bread, white, commercially prepared (includes soft bread crumbs)

pav.usda: Rolls, dinner, plain, commercially prepared (includes brown-and-serve)

toor-dal.usda: Pigeon peas (red gram), mature seeds, raw

chana-dal.usda: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, raw

kala-chana.usda: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, raw
kala-chana.approx: brown chickpea approximated by kabuli chickpea

chickpeas.usda: Chickpeas (garbanzo beans, bengal gram), mature seeds, raw

urad-dal.approx: black gram approximated by black bean

whole-urad.approx: black gram approximated by black bean

rajma.usda: Beans, kidney, red, mature seeds, raw

lobia.usda: Cowpeas, common (blackeyes, crowder, southern), mature seeds, raw

dried-peas.usda: Peas, green, split, mature seeds, raw

horse-gram.usda: Beans, pinto, mature seeds, raw (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
horse-gram.approx: no USDA entry; pinto bean used as a comparable dry pulse

sprouted-moth.usda: Mung beans, mature seeds, sprouted, raw
sprouted-moth.approx: moth bean approximated by sprouted mung

tomato.usda: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

sweet-potato.usda: Sweet potato, raw, unprepared (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

methi-leaves.approx: fresh fenugreek leaf is not in USDA; the seed is used, which is denser. Treated as approximate

spring-onion.usda: Onions, spring or scallions (includes tops and bulb), raw

curry-leaves.approx: no USDA entry; fresh coriander leaf used. Curry leaves are a tempering aromatic used in small amounts

milk.usda: Milk, whole, 3.25% milkfat, without added vitamin A and vitamin D

khoya.usda: Milk, dry, whole, without added vitamin D

tofu.usda: Tofu, raw, firm, prepared with calcium sulfate

chicken.usda: Chicken, broilers or fryers, meat only, raw

mutton.approx: Indian mutton is usually goat, so USDA goat (109 kcal/100g) is used rather than lamb (282 kcal/100g). Lamb would nearly treble the fat on every mutton dish

beef.usda: Beef, round, top round, steak, separable lean only, trimmed to 1/8" fat, all grades, raw

pork.usda: Pork, fresh, loin, whole, separable lean only, raw

dried-fish.usda: Fish, cod, Atlantic, dried and salted

asafoetida.approx: no USDA entry; a spice proxy used. Quantities are tiny (a pinch), so the effect on a serving is negligible

amchur.approx: dry mango powder approximated by dried mango

black-salt.approx: kala namak approximated by table salt

garam-masala.approx: blend, not a single food; USDA curry powder used

panch-phoron.approx: five-seed blend; cumin used as the representative seed

stone-flower.approx: no USDA entry; a leaf spice proxy used, quantities are tiny

kokum.approx: no USDA entry; tamarind used as the nearest souring fruit

jaggery.approx: jaggery is not in USDA; granulated sugar used, which is close on calories and carbohydrate but ignores jaggery's small mineral content

dried-coconut.usda: Nuts, coconut meat, dried (desiccated), not sweetened

coconut-milk.usda: Nuts, coconut milk, canned (liquid expressed from grated meat and water)

soy-sauce.usda: Soy sauce made from soy and wheat (shoyu)

baking-soda.note: contributes no energy in the amounts used
